source_lattice.attribution: The FCC space-filling rhombic-dodecahedron lattice is classical. This explicit canonical2D3 basis and its elementary proof are used only as a source for finite new constructions; no invention of the infinite tiling is claimed.
source_lattice.lattice_description: 2D3={2z:z in Z^3, sum(z) even}. The basis has off-diagonal entries2 and diagonal entries0.

source_lattice_proof.infinite_argument: Every nonzero2D3 vector has either a coordinate of absolute value>=4, or at least two coordinates of absolute value2: a lone coordinate+-2 violates the even-sum condition. In both cases some signed pair-coordinate facet has dot product>=4, which is the support of2Kprime. Thus interiors of every pair of classical cells are disjoint.
source_lattice_proof.tail_check_scope: The342 listed finite words supplement the elementary all-word argument; they are not used alone to infer its infinite conclusion.

construction.initial_centers_decoder: In normalized coordinates B*lattice_word-boundary_mark.point, using the exact rational basis. Boundary marks are actual canonical source-owner vertices, edge midpoints or face centroids with retained vertex indices.
construction.physical_operation: Cut a finite set of complete owners around one source-owner boundary mark. Retain a realized directed facet separator for every pair and restore all12 common host walls. Any following contact return uses only facets exposed on the actual preceding complete packing. Owner frames remain identity.
construction.native_decoder: Multiply the exact rational normalized centers by(3sqrt2/8)*(100000001/100000000), round to binary64 and retain identity quaternions. Use exact nominal scale*(1+1e-8)+1e-8 rounded outward. The full native checker treats all numeric inputs as exact rationals.

contribution.method: New complete finite selections and marked boundary-return constructions from exact classical lattice sources, with compatible whole-owner continuations. Distinct finite lattice selections are identified separately from deformed returns; original lattice attribution and complete construction ancestry are retained. Comparison uses the strongest pinned public native, nominal and retained construction baselines. The archive retains complete native coordinates, explicit physical construction decoders, original source and donor credits, independent geometry and construction reviews, and SHA256 manifests. All 32 witnesses pass the unmodified upstream floating checker and exact certifier.
